_comment: Frequently asked questions. Hand-edited. Answers must match data/practical.json and the agreed registration rules — change both together. Links in answers are written as {label|url} and rendered as anchors.

items.q: When and where is Energy Planning Week 2026?
items.a: 1–4 December 2026 at the GIZ Campus Forum, Friedrich-Ebert-Allee 32, 53113 Bonn, Germany. The Week runs in a hybrid format: on site in Bonn and online through Microsoft Teams. All times are CET.

The Week is designed primarily for government energy planners and policymakers, alongside representatives of the energy industry, financial institutions, regulators, utilities, intergovernmental organisations and the scientific and modelling community. Anyone interested is welcome to follow the sessions online.

items.q: Can I register to attend in Bonn?
items.a: Registration is currently open for online participation only. On-site places (up to 120) are confirmed directly by the co-hosts, with priority for speakers, government planners, and members and partners of the LTES Network, GCEP and GET.transform.
Complete the {registration form|https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/UhjVrHEPrx} to join online. Connection details (Microsoft Teams) are shared with registered online participants ahead of the event.

items.q: I need a visa to travel to Germany. What should I do?
items.a: Apply as early as possible: Schengen visa appointments in some countries are booked months ahead. IRENA can provide a visa support letter for participants attending in person on request; contact {LTES@irena.org|mailto:LTES@irena.org}. Passport details are requested separately, and only once your place is confirmed. Please do not send them by email.

items.q: Can I follow the Week online?
items.a: Yes. All plenary and numbered sessions are streamed on Microsoft Teams, except the closed-door LTES Network strategic meeting on Day 2. The joining link is published on this page before the event.

items.q: What language are the sessions in?
Who do I contact with questions?
items.a: Write to the LTES Network at {LTES@irena.org|mailto:LTES@irena.org}.
